title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ADJUSTING THE DIVIDEND RATES OF SELECTED GOVERNMENT OWNED AND/OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS ON THEIR 1994 EARNINGS PURSUANT TO SECTION 5 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO.

text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and
remitted by the following government owned and /or controlled corporations
as dividends to the National Government (NG) as provided for under Section
3 of Republic Act No. 7656 is adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to
the rates specified therein:
1. Land Bank of the Philippines
2. Manila International Airport Authority
3. Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System
4. National Electrification Administration
5. Philippine Center for Economic Development
6. Public Estates Authority
In the case of Philippine National Oil Company (PNOC), a 50%
dividend rate should be applied on its net earnings after deducting the
remittance made to NG from the PETRON privatization proceeds equivalent
to 50%* thereof under Executive Order No. 37; provided further that said
dividend should be paid in cash.

2

The adjusted dividend rates provided for under Section I are
only applicable on 1994 net earnings of the concerned government owned
and/or controlled corporations.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14th day of July
year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Five.
By the President:
RUBEN D. TORRES
Executive Secretary
